compliance.summary: The homepage presents GoGloby as an Applied AI implementation and measurement company, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency described in the approved materials. It also promotes discontinued offers and includes unsupported or conflicting claims about timelines, security, clients, figures, and offices.

llm_problems.title: Old Applied AI positioning
llm_problems.issue: The homepage describes GoGloby as an Applied AI company and engineering partner that implements and measures AI delivery, instead of using the approved staffing and recruiting positioning.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the page's central positioning with the approved company description and describe recruiting and staffing as GoGloby's services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.page_value: Applied AI company and engineering partner
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers
